basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old graphic designer based in Seattle with a love for all things fantasy and anime. I spend my days working on digital art commissions and my evenings diving into Reddit discussions about my favorite shows and books. I'm single, enjoy attending local comic conventions, and often browse Reddit during lunch breaks and late at night. I have a penchant for collecting unique props, which fuels my interest in ornate scythes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive self-taught knowledge in graphic design and digital illustration. This expertise was honed through years of online courses and practical experience working freelance. Additionally, a deep familiarity with anime and fantasy genres, built through decades of avid consumption and participation in related communities.
